tasks.title: Create a file inside the container
tasks.instructions:
Use `lxc exec` to create a file inside the `web` container:

```bash
lxc exec web -- touch /root/helloworld.txt
```

Verify it exists:
```bash
lxc exec web -- cat /root/helloworld.txt
```
(No output since it's empty.)
hints: lxc exec <name> -- <command> runs a single command inside the instance.
tasks.solution:
```bash
lxc exec web -- touch /root/helloworld.txt
lxc exec web -- cat /root/helloworld.txt
```

tasks.title: Pull, modify, and push the file
tasks.instructions:
Pull the file from the container to your host, add content, and push it back:

```bash
lxc file pull web/root/helloworld.txt .
echo "Hello world" > helloworld.txt
lxc file push helloworld.txt web/root/helloworld.txt
```

Verify the content inside the container:
```bash
lxc exec web -- cat /root/helloworld.txt
```
hints: lxc file pull <instance>/<path> <destination> copies from the instance to the host.
lxc file push <source> <instance>/<path> copies from the host to the instance.
tasks.solution:
```bash
lxc file pull web/root/helloworld.txt .
echo "Hello world" > helloworld.txt
lxc file push helloworld.txt web/root/helloworld.txt
lxc exec web -- cat /root/helloworld.txt
```

tasks.title: Create a snapshot
tasks.instructions:
Create a snapshot of the `web` container named `backup`:

```bash
lxc snapshot web backup
```

Verify the snapshot exists:
```bash
lxc info web
```
Look for the `Snapshots:` section at the bottom.
hints: lxc snapshot <instance> <name> creates a point-in-time snapshot.
Check the Snapshots section at the bottom of lxc info output.
tasks.solution:
```bash
lxc snapshot web backup
lxc info web
```

tasks.title: Delete the file and restore from snapshot
tasks.instructions:
Delete the file inside the container, then restore from the snapshot:

```bash
lxc exec web -- rm /root/helloworld.txt
lxc exec web -- ls /root/helloworld.txt
```
(This should fail — file is gone.)

Now restore:
```bash
lxc restore web backup
```

Verify the file is back:
```bash
lxc exec web -- cat /root/helloworld.txt
```
hints: After rm, the file is gone. lxc restore brings it back from the snapshot.
The restored file should still contain 'Hello world'.
tasks.solution:
```bash
lxc exec web -- rm /root/helloworld.txt
lxc restore web backup
lxc exec web -- cat /root/helloworld.txt
```
